sehemu: Part V: Court of Appeal of the United Republic
jina: Quorum at sittings of the Court of Appeal
maudhui: (1) The quorum at every sitting of the Court of Appeal shall be not less than three Justices of Appeal. (2) In every appeal a matter which requires the decision by the Court of Appeal shall be decided on the basis of the majority opinion of the Justices of Appeal hearing the appeal.
vifungu: (1) The quorum at every sitting of the Court of Appeal shall be not less than three Justices of Appeal.
(2) In every appeal a matter which requires the decision by the Court of Appeal shall be decided on the basis of the majority opinion of the Justices of Appeal hearing the appeal.
